title: Model Market Matrix - provider entry
description: A place a model can be bought or served from. `adapter` joins to ace.gateway.providers: a model is only REACHABLE if its provider's adapter is registered AND the tenant holds credentials for it. That join is the gap this KB exists to close.

adapter.description: ProviderAdapter.name in ace.gateway.providers, or 'self-hosted' for fleet.yaml destinations.

integration.description: implemented = an adapter is registered today. planned = declared in PLANNED_PROVIDERS, errors clearly if selected. external = reachable only via an OpenAI-compatible base_url, no bespoke adapter.

credentials.description: Config keys a tenant must supply for this provider to be reachable.
